title: Structured debate and bounded adjudication
description: Runs two positions through a fixed number of rounds before a judge issues a reasoned ruling.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: structured-debate-bounded-adjudication
  title: Structured debate and bounded adjudication
  description: Runs two positions through a fixed number of rounds before a judge issues a reasoned ruling.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Resolve contested questions through evidence-based adversarial reasoning.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 2
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - ruling-acceptance
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Proposition and evidence packet
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - question
          - evidence
          - rounds
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: position-a
      kind: agent
      name: Position A advocate
      role: Evidence-based advocate
      prompt: Argue for the proposition using supplied evidence. Identify uncertainty and rebut opposing claims.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
        tools:
          - read
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: position-b
      kind: agent
      name: Position B advocate
      role: Evidence-based advocate
      prompt: Argue against the proposition using supplied evidence. Identify uncertainty and rebut opposing claims.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
        tools:
          - read
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: debate
      kind: loop
      name: Bounded debate rounds
      config:
        body:
          - position-a
          - position-b
        exitCondition: iteration >= intake.rounds
        maxIterations: 5
        onExhausted: continue
    - id: judge
      kind: agent
      name: Debate judge
      role: Neutral adjudicator
      prompt: Evaluate claims by evidentiary support, address unresolved points, and issue a reasoned ruling with confidence.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: ruling-acceptance
      kind: approval
      name: Sponsor accepts ruling
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Debate transcript and adjudicated ruling
  edges:
    - id: e1
      from: intake
      to: position-a
      kind: data
    - id: e2
      from: intake
      to: position-b
      kind: data
    - id: e3
      from: position-a
      to: debate
      kind: data
    - id: e4
      from: position-b
      to: debate
      kind: data
    - id: e5
      from: debate
      to: judge
      kind: control
      condition: loop_exit
    - id: e6
      from: judge
      to: ruling-acceptance
      kind: dependency
    - id: e7
      from: ruling-acceptance
      to: result
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
    - id: debate-exhausted
      from: debate
      to: judge
      kind: control
      condition: loop_exhausted
